Before and After

Socket Replacement

Cracked Socket Replaced

The old double socket had cracked right across the front and was hanging out of the wall. It was taken out and a new double socket with built-in USB charging fitted in its place.

Before After
Switch Upgrade

Brushed Steel Switch Upgrade

A plain white switch that had come away from the wall, swapped for a brushed steel switch with an indicator light and fitted flush beside the heating control.
